description.en: Sets a decorative avatar/accessory model on a match member, by character ID, avatar ID string, and attachment slot.
Character ID string identifying the member to attach the avatar to.
True once the avatar has been attached; null if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Attach a decorative avatar accessory to a match member
CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER("para_cp0370", "ck0024", 1);
